 Live .  3,425 viewing 3425 viewing WSL: Watch as Chelsea score four v Charlton, West Ham, Spurs and Brighton winning
 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scores 
 Tables 
 Summary
 LIVE: Brighton 2-1 Palace - Blanchard scores for Eagles, Hayes and Peskett score for Seagulls 
 LIVE: Birmingham 1-3 Spurs - Blakstad , Holdt and Gaupset net for Spurs, Herron nets for Blues 
 LIVE: West Ham 4-0 Liverpool - Asseyi , Wandeler and Codina on scoresheet 
 LIVE: Charlton 0-4 Chelsea - watch live on BBC Two and top of page 
 Bjorn , Malard , Carpenter on scoresheet for Blues
 Earlier, Arsenal drew with Villa and Man City beat London City 
 Who will win the WSL? Send us your views 
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Elizabeth Botcherby, Michael Emons & Adam Millington
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Birmingham 1-3 Tottenham 
 So nearly two in quick succession for Birmingham! Rebecca McKenna brings a good save out of Lize Kop. 
 1 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:22 GMT 15:22 GMT 
 Click the yellow 'Get involved' box at the top of this page 
 Today's result aside and, yes, a long way to go, but Gareth Taylor has done a good job so far. The Keating signing was a strange one though. She's always been an accident waiting to happen with the ball at her feet. The latest one against London City being yet another calamitous example.
 Toby, Cambs 
 8 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Birmingham 1-3 Tottenham published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Neve Herron (64 mins) 
 Poacher's finish from Neve Herron ! Birmingham have pulled one back. 
 14 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Charlton 0-4 Chelsea 
 Another late chance just before the break as Manaka Matsukubo plays a nice flick through to ellie Carpenter, but the goalkeeper collects.
 Chelsea with a commanding lead as the whistle blows
 8 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Brighton 2-1 Crystal Palace published at 15:20 GMT 15:20 GMT 
 Sophie Peskett (64 mins) 
 Sophie Peskett has her first WSL goal! 
 It all starts with Olivia Garcia and Manuela Vanegas on the left. The ball is pulled back to Emilie Joramo and her shot deflects into the path of Peskett. 
 27 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - West Ham 4-0 Liverpool published at 62 mins 62 mins 
 Viviane Asseyi 
 A wonderful goal from Viviane Asseyi, who gets her second of the afternoon and West Ham's fourth.
 Asseyi wins a free-kick in a dangerous position 22 yards out and she hits the set piece superbly, curling a fine effort with the ball going in just under the crossbar.
 17 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 15:19 GMT 15:19 GMT 
 Birmingham 0-3 Tottenham 
 A couple of changes for Tottenham. 
 Signe Gaupset and Matilda Vinberg make way for Evaliina Summanen and Kirsty Hanson. 
 3 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 West Ham 3-0 Liverpool 
 Japan striker Riko Ueki, back after a month out of WSL action because of injury, comes on for West Ham, replacing Kelly Gago.
 5 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 Brighton 1-1 Crystal Palace 
 Chiamaka Nnadozie was caught off her line in the first half and the Brighton goalkeeper has not learned her lesson! Fortunately for her, Bethany England's effort goes just wide. 
 2 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Brighton 1-1 Crystal Palace published at 15:16 GMT 15:16 GMT 
 Caitlin Hayes (59 mins) 
 All square at the Broadfield Stadium! Pinpoint delivery to the back post where Caitlin Hayes out-jumps three or four Palace defenders to nod home. 
 That's Brighton's 200th WSL goal. 
 23 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:16 GMT 15:16 GMT 
 Charlton 0-4 Chelsea 
 Manaka Matsukubo, on her full WSL debut, has another effort from the edge of the area but this one is easily pushed away by Anna Koivunen.
 Five minutes of stoppage time added at the end of the first half.
 5 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:15 GMT 15:15 GMT 
 West Ham 3-0 Liverpool 
 West Ham are pushing for more goals and have two chances in quick succession. Viviane Asseyi cuts in on to her right foot and her strike is blocked but drops to Kelly Gago, who can only send the rebound effort wide of the post.
 4 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:15 GMT 15:15 GMT 
 Brighton 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 Great leaping save from Pauline Peyraud-Magnin to deny Emilie Jaramo. Two big hands from the Palace kepeer!
 But again, Brighton's promising position all came from Olivia Garcia's dancing feet. 
 4 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:14 GMT 15:14 GMT 
 Birmingham 0-3 Tottenham 
 Lily Crosthwaite will be glad to see the offside flag go up! The Birmingham sub rather tripped over her own feet as she tried to slot home Oceane Hurtre's low cross. 
 Hurtre once again had acres of space on the wing. 
 2 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:13 GMT 15:13 GMT 
 Click the yellow 'Get involved' box at the top of this page 
 Has Gareth Taylor improved this Liverpool squad in any way? I'm not so sure.
 Karl, Cardiff 
 11 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:13 GMT 15:13 GMT 
 West Ham 3-0 Liverpool 
 Liverpool's Alice Bergstrom does well to get to the byline for the visitors, but then puts too much on the cross. But the Reds rebuild and come again with Bergstrom hitting a well-struck shot at goal, but Constance Picaud-Inconnu does well to not just save the ball, but hold on to it too.
 Cornelia Kapocs gets a chance not too much later for Liverpool but over it goes.
 4 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:12 GMT 15:12 GMT 
 Charlton 0-4 Chelsea 
 That was speculative to say the least, but Charlton have their first shot.
 They overturn the ball in the middle and Cassandra Korhonen has a crack from about 20 yards out and it soars over.
 4 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:12 GMT 15:12 GMT 
 Brighton 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 Plenty of possession for Brighton early in this second half but nothing to trouble Pauline Peyraud-Magnin. 
 5 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:11 GMT 15:11 GMT 
 Click the yellow 'Get involved' box at the top of this page 
 @Roberto [14:57] - yep, I agree but hard to argue that Charlton just don't seem ready for the WSL (especially when you compare their performances to Birmingham)
 Sophia, Bristol 
 8 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Birmingham 0-3 Tottenham published at 15:11 GMT 15:11 GMT 
 Signe Gaupset (53 mins) 
 Ah, erm, what was I saying? Signe Gaupset adds Tottenham's third.
 Her low right-footed effort beats the sprawling Sophie Baggaley.
